correctness.rationale: The 4-by-4 characteristic polynomial and its exact far-detuned rescaling are algebraically verified. The limiting quadratic has precisely two folds, the nonzero IFT Jacobian establishes nearby unique analytic fold curves, and compact root separation yields the quantified interval-wide real-root classification. The derivative yields both threshold coefficients. A nonzero Schur off-diagonal at the double eigenvalue proves algebraic multiplicity two and geometric multiplicity one. The packaged script reproduces the symbolic identities and sample finite-parameter folds. The theorem explicitly excludes arbitrary onsite detuning and degenerate asymmetry.

value.rationale: Quantifies a practically meaningful loss of spectral pinning when one superconducting dot is far off resonance. The exact inverse-square half-width and nonzero next correction specify gate-tuning tolerance, and the sharp count plus geometric defectiveness distinguish a topological exceptional-point boundary from a small ordinary splitting. This addresses a natural missing remote-detuning regime in the originating qualitative phase diagram rather than an unmotivated finite case.
